current_model.score: inverse average-rank percentile of rounded income proxy among eligible, complete-coverage Amsterdam cells; ties equal; lower income = higher score
current_model.grid_transfer: exact polygon overlap in EPSG:3035; area-weighted mean of published neighbourhood medians; NOT a cell median or household estimate
current_model.publication: all four scenarios use surface temperature, green deficit and low income; no separate income scenario
current_model.missing_policy: null values; no zero substitution, no parent-area imputation, no name-based matching
current_model.missing_reason: source non-publication confirmed by raw marker; individual cause not inferred
current_model.boundary_policy: exact code join candidate; spatial boundaries must be checked before grid transfer
current_model.comparability: Brussels equivalence scale, coverage and household/person weighting remain unresolved
current_model.boundary_source: site CBS 2025 neighbourhood polygons, export_web_data.py layer amsterdam_neighbourhoods_2025
current_model.coverage_rule: minimum 99.9% of clipped cell area; within 0.1% is a geometric tolerance, not income imputation; partial values remain unscored
current_model.neighbourhood_summary: exact area-weighted mean of complete three-indicator cell scores; >=99.9% eligible overlap coverage and >=50% mapped neighbourhood coverage required
current_model.brussels: no ranking until comparable income is available
current_model.heat_source: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level 2 JJA 2019–2023; observed median land-surface temperature; within-city average-rank percentile among eligible cells with observed LST

validation_status: No predictive validation or 500m/1km sensitivity result is claimed for this revised three-indicator index.
